synopsis: The second season of MASHLE , adapting the Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc. After Mash Burnedead's clash with Magia Lupus, the secret about his powers is now out in the open. However, an evil shadow organization called Innocent Zero hijacks the inquiry to demand that Mash be kept alive. Mash proves that he is capable of dealing with Innocent Zero, but the Divine Visionaries' verdict remains unchanged. Luckily, Mash finds unexpected allies in Divine Visionary Rayne Ames and Headmaster Wahlberg Baigan, and they successfully defer his execution until Innocent Zero is defeated. Mash is now allowed to live under one condition: he must be selected as the Divine Visionary candidate by the year's end. (Source: MAL Rewrite)
